name: Springfield JCC Summer Camp
description_short: A full day camp for children ages 5 and up on the Springfield JCC's 20-acre campus. It offers Traditional Camp, Inclusion Camp and 2-4-1 Sports Camp, and teens ages 14-15 can join a Counselors in Training program. The camp is rooted in Jewish values and open to children of all backgrounds.
activities: Indoor and outdoor sports and games
special_needs_notes: The Inclusion Camp supports children with different abilities so they can take part in camp with their peers. Financial aid covers Inclusion Camp.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers swim in the JCC's pool. Traditional Camp has two swim lessons and two free swims each week, with a swim test every Monday; lifeguards hold the required certifications.
